subject: BLOCKER before Act I of le-01-cold-horizon ships: seed flag_registry for missions 2 and 3
description:
Missions 2 (Ghost Session) and 3 (Last Good Contact) are BUILT and pass 28/28 in _tools/qa/cold-horizon/act1-test.js, but their flag VALUES are not seeded. Values live in Firestore flag_registry/le-01-cold-horizon (admin-write only, never in config -- BoxEngine pre-fetches config flags to the client, which is why 231 boxes hand out their answers). Until m2-ghost-session and m3-last-good-contact are seeded, submitFlag rejects every correct answer to those missions and the box can never reach 3/3. Exact shape of the 2026-08-04 bug where 88 boxes were solvable and never creditable. The arena card now reads flags:3 to match config-shared.js. DO NOT DEPLOY Act I until seeded. Box is status:'coming-soon' (dimmed, still playable).
[2026-08-09 01:54] UPDATED 2026-08-09: mission 4 'Signed in Ash' also landed, so THREE flags need seeding, not two: m2-ghost-session, m3-last-good-contact, m4-signed-in-ash. Arena card now reads flags:4. Box cannot reach 4/4 until all three are in flag_registry/le-01-cold-horizon.
[2026-08-11 00:43] Verified resolved 2026-08-10 20:50. flag_registry/le-01-cold-horizon holds 42 flags and 27 alias spellings; m2-ghost-session is seeded with 2 alias spellings, m3-last-good-contact is seeded. Act I shipped and both missions are creditable: the #306 browser e2e credited m6-dead-air end to end against production this session, exercising the same validateFlag registry path. Closing because a stale BLOCKER on shipped work misdirects whoever reads the board next.
